items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Loading trail: role=status with an accessible name, 8 decorative 2 px dots on a 12 px box; each dot fades linearly with a lap/8 stagger so a smooth tail follows the head around the ring. Reduced: one slow opacity pulse; off: static three-dot arc.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. The dots are CSS squares and a Web Animation; no original assets are used. v4: no stepped easing; the orbit is a linear opacity trail.
